purpose: Record the P21 project layout governance convergence evidence, commit checkpoints, covered boundaries, verification gates, deferred physical migrations, and admission criteria for future examples grouping.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): enforce top-level directory boundaries
roundCommits.coverage: Every tracked top-level directory has an explicit category, purpose, and known validation gate.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): classify governance script families
roundCommits.coverage: Every tracked bin/scripts file belongs to exactly one script family while physical script moves remain deferred.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): index reference governance files
roundCommits.coverage: Every tracked docs/reference file belongs to a reference family with category, owner, purpose, and gate.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): gate command file families
roundCommits.coverage: Every cmd/gofly/internal/command Go file is covered by a prefix family or explicit shared-file family.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): require examples readiness metadata
roundCommits.coverage: Every examples directory declares kind, command, verify command, ports, dependency mode, copyable state, smoke gate, README source, and rollback note.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): block ignored artifact drift
roundCommits.coverage: Runtime state, generated top-level docs, benchmark transients, coverage output, and local binaries remain ignored and untracked.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): own tracked root files
roundCommits.coverage: Every tracked root-level file belongs to exactly one module, governance, release, container, or documentation ownership family.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): gate docs taxonomy boundaries
roundCommits.coverage: Every tracked docs subdirectory belongs to a documentation taxonomy family while docs/superpowers remains local-only.

roundCommits.title: chore(layout): classify deploy asset families
roundCommits.coverage: Every tracked deploy file belongs to a Helm or Kustomize asset family and renders through the cloud-native gate.

verificationGates.scope: Primary blocking layout contract covering directory, root file, scripts, reference docs, command files, deploy assets, ignored artifacts, docs taxonomy, examples readiness, and test naming policy.
Confirms durable governance inventory remains coherent with active project governance evidence.
Confirms Diataxis-style documentation navigation and taxonomy entrypoints still render as expected.
Confirms deploy asset families still render through Helm/Kustomize or explicit static fallback.
Confirms examples readiness metadata remains aligned with runnable examples; Go module stat-cache write warnings are local sandbox noise and did not affect the exit code.
Confirms committed layout contract changes do not introduce whitespace errors.

deferredMigrations.reason: Examples now have grouping and readiness contracts, but physical grouping would touch many gates and user-facing paths. Keep current paths stable until one family qualifies and migrates in a dedicated commit.
deferredMigrations.futurePolicy: Move at most one examples family per migration, update README, Makefile gates, smoke scripts, module replace paths, and rollback notes in the same commit.

deferredMigrations.reason: Script ownership is now classified, but the flat script directory remains compatible with Makefile and CI entrypoints.
deferredMigrations.futurePolicy: Move one script family only after its Makefile target and every direct script reference are updated and shell syntax checks pass.

deferredMigrations.reason: Reference docs and evidence are now indexed by family, but existing docs-check and release references assume the flat docs/reference layout.
deferredMigrations.futurePolicy: Prefer adding contract index coverage before any physical split; migrate one reference family only when downstream docs and scripts are updated.

deferredMigrations.reason: Command files now have family ownership, but package splitting would affect CLI wiring, tests, internal imports, and JSON contract goldens.
deferredMigrations.futurePolicy: Split only when a command family has isolated dependencies and contract tests proving CLI behavior is unchanged.

examplesPhysicalMigrationAdmission.policy: Do not physically group examples until one family can move without breaking copyable modules, smoke scripts, docs links, or generated path expectations.
requiredSignals: examplesGroupingPlan.status remains planned-only until the target family is selected
target family has a dedicated migration issue or task id
all examples in the target family pass make examples-smoke before and after the move
go.mod module paths and local replace directives are updated for moved examples
examples/README.md matrix and commands are updated in the same commit
all direct script, docs, and Makefile references to moved paths are updated
rollback note documents how to restore the old path or route users during the transition
migration moves exactly one examples family and does not combine unrelated layout changes

runtimeIgnoredPolicy.rule: Runtime evidence and generated local artifacts remain ignored; commit only durable source, docs/reference contracts, scripts, and release evidence.

nextRecommendation.action: Keep P22 focused on ratcheting the existing layout contracts and only consider one-family examples migration after the admission gates pass without path drift.
